players.name: Drake Maye
players.note: He hurt his right ankle on a first-quarter sack by Aidan Hutchinson in the Nov. 15 loss to Detroit in Munich and did not return (3-of-4, 48 yards). Mike Vrabel said more tests are needed before a diagnosis; no MRI result had been reported as of Nov. 17. New England is on bye in Week 11, and Tommy DeVito would start in Week 12 if Maye can't play.

players.name: Geno Smith
players.note: Against Buffalo on Nov. 15, he was evaluated for a concussion after a hit late in the first half, came back for one series, then left with an ankle injury and did not return (13-of-21, 148 yards). Aaron Glenn said Smith's availability for Week 11 at the Chargers will be decided during the week.

players.name: Cade Klubnik
players.note: The rookie made his NFL debut in relief of the injured Geno Smith on Nov. 15 vs. Buffalo, going 11-of-20 for 137 yards with one interception and running 3 times for 26 yards. He is the likely Week 11 starter at the Chargers if Smith (concussion evaluation/ankle) can't go.

players.name: Jacoby Brissett
players.note: In his first Ravens start, on MNF Nov. 16 vs. the Chargers, he went 33-of-49 for 340 yards with no touchdowns and one interception. The volume was big, but he scored only 12.8 PPR points; he remains Baltimore's starter with Lamar Jackson on IR.

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: He remains on IR after right-thumb surgery and is likely out for the season. Jacoby Brissett started on MNF Nov. 16 and threw for 340 yards.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.note: He missed the Week 10 win at Green Bay with a Grade 2 hamstring strain while Kirk Cousins started. Minnesota is targeting a Week 12 return vs. Atlanta on Nov. 29, so he is expected to sit again in Week 11.

players.name: Kirk Cousins
players.note: In the Nov. 15 30-10 win at Green Bay he went 21-of-31 for 207 yards with 2 TDs and 1 INT. He should start again in Week 11 while Kyler Murray (hamstring) targets a Week 12 return.

players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.note: He is still dealing with the lower-leg (ankle/foot) injury from the Nov. 8 loss to Chicago and has been in and out of a walking boot over the bye. As of Nov. 15, NFL Network called him in danger of missing Week 11 at Detroit on Nov. 22; the injury is not seen as long-term.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.note: He missed Week 10 with quad and rib injuries while Drew Lock went 14-of-17 for 240 yards and 2 TDs in the 21-13 win at Las Vegas. Seattle is on bye in Week 11, so Week 12 is the earliest he can return.

players.name: Deshaun Watson
players.note: He went 25-of-40 for 312 yards with 1 INT, plus 49 rushing yards and a TD, in Cleveland's 27-24 comeback win over Houston on Nov. 15. The performance should keep him ahead of Shedeur Sanders for now.

players.name: Shedeur Sanders
players.note: He did not play on Nov. 15 while Deshaun Watson (312 passing yards, a rushing TD) led Cleveland's 27-24 comeback win over Houston. Another start soon looks unlikely.

players.name: Fernando Mendoza
players.note: In his first NFL start, a 21-13 loss to Seattle on Nov. 15, he went 17-of-29 for 143 yards and ran 6 times for 22 yards and a TD (13.9 PPR points). He remains the Raiders' starter, and his rushing gives him a fantasy floor.

players.name: Carson Beck
players.note: His first NFL start, against the Rams on Nov. 15, was rough: 11-of-18 for 108 yards, 0 TDs and 2 INTs (2.4 PPR points). He stays Arizona's starter because Gardner Minshew is on season-ending IR, but his fantasy floor is very low.

players.name: Jalen Hurts
players.note: He remains on IR with blood clots in his lungs and is expected to miss the rest of 2026.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.note: He remains on IR and is reported to be out for the season. J.J. McCarthy is the Giants' starter.

players.name: Malik Willis
players.note: Miami placed him on IR on Nov. 10 with a groin/core-muscle injury, so he will miss at least four games. Kyle McCord is starting in his place.

players.name: Emmett Johnson
players.note: In his first NFL start (Nov. 15 at Atlanta), Johnson had 22 carries for 101 yards and 6 catches for 70 yards and 2 TDs (32.1 half-PPR) while playing 57 of 65 snaps, per Sleeper stats. Kenneth Walker III (groin) remains out for now, and Johnson has a case for a bigger share even after Walker returns.

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.note: Walker (groin) missed the Nov. 15 win at Atlanta and is still listed out on Sleeper. His next chance to play is Week 11 vs. Arizona on Nov. 22, but rookie Emmett Johnson's 171-yard, 2-TD start could cut into his workload.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: Marks suffered a concussion on Nov. 15 vs. Cleveland and did not return. Reports say he is not likely to be cleared for Houston's short-week Thursday game vs. the Colts (Nov. 19).

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Montgomery (groin) missed Week 10, and DeMeco Ryans said he is uncertain for Thursday's Nov. 19 game vs. the Colts, calling it day-to-day. With Woody Marks likely out with a concussion, Montgomery would lead the backfield if he is cleared.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.note: Jacobs (fractured finger, surgery Nov. 13) missed the Nov. 15 loss to Minnesota and was not placed on IR, so the expected absence is about 2-3 weeks.

players.name: Kaleb Johnson
players.note: Starting for the injured Josh Jacobs, Johnson ran 10 times for 42 yards on Nov. 15 vs. Minnesota, but on only 14 of 55 snaps, per Sleeper. He is the lead early-down back while Jacobs (finger) is out for an expected 2-3 weeks.

players.name: Kyren Williams
players.note: Per Sleeper's Week 10 stats (Nov. 15), Williams had just 12 carries for 23 yards plus 2 catches for 9 yards, while Blake Corum out-carried him 17-12 on an even 39-39 snap split. The Rams appear to be moving toward a committee.

players.name: Blake Corum
players.note: Corum out-carried Kyren Williams 17-12 in Week 10 (Nov. 15), putting up 100 rushing yards and a TD plus 3 catches for 19 yards, and the two split snaps 39-39, per Sleeper stats. That points to a growing role in the Rams backfield.

players.name: Cam Skattebo
players.note: Back from a hamstring injury, Skattebo handled a featured role on Nov. 12 vs. Washington, playing 58 of 65 snaps with 18 carries for 78 yards and 2 TDs plus 3 catches for 44 yards (25.7 half-PPR), per Sleeper.

players.name: Adam Randall
players.note: Randall did not play in Monday night's Nov. 16 game vs. the Chargers and remains on IR on Sleeper. His 21-day practice window opened in late October, so the Ravens have to decide on his activation soon.

players.name: Nicholas Singleton
players.note: Singleton was a healthy scratch (coach's decision) on Nov. 15 vs. Jacksonville, while Tony Pollard (8 catches, 1 TD) and Tyjae Spears both played.

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.note: The Patriots placed Henderson (illness) on injured reserve on Nov. 14, so he will miss at least four games.

players.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
players.note: Playing through a knee issue as the lead back with Henderson on IR, Stevenson managed 6 carries for 4 yards and 1 catch on 26 of 59 snaps in the Nov. 15 loss to Detroit, per Sleeper. Corey Kiner out-carried him 10-6.

players.name: Corey Kiner
players.note: With TreVeyon Henderson on IR, Kiner had 10 carries for 25 yards on 25 of 59 snaps in the Nov. 15 loss to Detroit, out-carrying an ineffective Rhamondre Stevenson (6 for 4), per Sleeper.

players.name: Seth McGowan
players.note: McGowan turned 17 snaps into 12 carries for 77 yards and a TD in Week 10 (Nov. 15), per Sleeper, in a meaningful change-of-pace role behind Jonathan Taylor (16 carries).

players.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
players.note: Croskey-Merritt (groin) remains on IR. Reports said he would first be eligible to return for Week 11 vs. Cincinnati, but there is no confirmed activation yet, and Rachaad White has been the lead back.

players.name: Kyle Monangai
players.note: Monangai (toe) is still listed out on Sleeper as of Nov. 16, coming out of Chicago's Week 10 bye. D'Andre Swift remains the lead back.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.note: Brooks remains on IR, recovering from core-muscle/abdominal surgery, as of Nov. 16. His practice window is open, but he has not been activated, and Chuba Hubbard just posted 31.7 half-PPR points on Nov. 15.

players.name: RJ Harvey
players.note: Harvey (knee) remains on IR as of Nov. 16, after Denver's Week 10 bye. With Jonah Coleman established as the lead back, Harvey's workload is likely to be reduced when he returns.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.note: Love (high ankle sprain) has been on IR since Nov. 3 and is expected to miss 4-5 weeks.

players.name: Demond Claiborne
players.note: Claiborne (knee) remains on injured reserve, where he has been since Nov. 9.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.note: Bowers hurt his right ankle on the opening drive in Week 10 (11 snaps, 2-18). On Monday, Nov 16, coach Klint Kubiak called him day-to-day, saying the injury is 'not as bad as we thought' but 'still a significant injury'; a high-ankle sprain has been reported but not confirmed, and his Week 11 status vs. Denver is uncertain.

players.name: Michael Mayer
players.note: Mayer played 49 of 59 snaps in Week 10 (2-16) after Brock Bowers left early with an ankle injury. Bowers is day-to-day as of Nov 16, so Mayer would be a streaming option in Week 11 vs. Denver if Bowers sits.

players.name: Travis Kelce
players.note: Kelce played only 20 of 65 snaps in Week 10 vs. Atlanta on Nov 15 (2-30). Andy Reid tied a calf issue to Kelce's lingering ankle injury, and Kelce said he is 'all good,' but there was no official Week 11 update as of Nov 16.

players.name: T.J. Hockenson
players.note: Hockenson (wrist/chest) missed Week 10. On Monday, Nov 16, Kevin O'Connell said the Vikings expect him to progress ahead of Week 11 vs. San Francisco, so he is trending toward a return, but nothing is confirmed.

players.name: Jake Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson (knee PCL/MCL sprain) missed Week 10 on Nov 15 and is still expected to miss multiple weeks. Brevyn Spann-Ford and Luke Schoonmaker are splitting Dallas' TE work.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson (hamstring) remains on IR. On Nov 14, Sean McVay said he would miss 'another couple weeks,' and waiver columns list him as a stash given the Rams' thin receiving corps.

players.name: Tyler Higbee
players.note: With Puka Nacua and Davante Adams sidelined, Higbee played 51 of 76 snaps in Week 10 and caught 3 passes for 17 yards and a TD. He remains the Rams' lead TE until Terrance Ferguson returns from IR.

players.name: Isaiah Likely
players.note: Likely posted 9 catches for 127 yards and a TD on 11 targets in Week 10 (Nov 15), playing 57 of 65 snaps, which makes him a clear every-down TE1 for the Giants.

players.name: Harold Fannin Jr.
players.note: Fannin played through his groin issue in Week 10 vs. Houston (Nov 15), catching 7 of 9 targets for 91 yards on 59 of 68 snaps. That is a strong every-down role.

players.name: Tyler Warren
players.note: Despite the Nov 10 trades of Josh Downs and Keenan Allen, Warren had only 2 catches for 1 yard on 3 targets (51 of 59 snaps) in Week 10. The target bump has not shown up yet, though his role is secure.

players.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
players.note: With Elijah Sarratt held out as a coach's decision, Lane drew 11 targets in the Nov 16 MNF game vs. the Chargers and caught 3 for 61 yards (Sleeper box score). He had been shut out in Week 9 and had just 1 target the game before vs. Buffalo.

players.name: Elijah Sarratt
players.note: Sarratt was out for the Nov 16 MNF game vs. the Chargers as a coach's decision, and Ja'Kobi Lane took on an 11-target role. His spot in Baltimore's rotation is now in question.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: Thompson (hamstring) missed the Nov 16 MNF game vs. Baltimore, his third straight absence. His Week 11 availability is unclear.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: Brown hurt his hamstring in the Nov 15 game vs. Detroit in Munich and was ruled out for the rest of the game, finishing with 2 catches for 27 yards on 28 of 59 snaps. Sleeper lists him out; New England has its Week 11 bye, and no timeline has been reported.

players.name: Drake London
players.note: London (head) did not return to the Nov 15 game vs. Kansas City after a concussion evaluation, finishing with 6 catches for 109 yards on 12 targets. As of Nov 16 there was no update on whether he is in the protocol, and Sleeper lists him questionable.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.note: Addison (thumb, hurt in practice Nov 13) missed the Nov 15 game at Green Bay, and Sleeper now lists him inactive/out. No IR move or Week 11 timeline was reported as of Nov 16.

players.name: Jauan Jennings
players.note: Jennings (calf) missed his second straight game on Nov 15 at Green Bay. No Week 11 update was found as of Nov 16.

players.name: Chris Bell
players.note: Bell (knee) missed the Nov 15 game at Indianapolis, and Sleeper still lists him out. Caleb Douglas led Miami's receivers with 8 targets in his absence.

players.name: Caleb Douglas
players.note: With Chris Bell (knee) out, Douglas played 58 of 69 snaps on Nov 15 at Indianapolis and caught 3 of 8 targets for 71 yards. He holds a starting role while Bell is out.

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.note: Tate (shoulder) missed the Nov 15 game vs. Jacksonville and Sleeper still lists him out. His Week 11 status is unclear.

players.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
players.note: Back from a three-game hamstring absence, Samuel played 44 of 65 snaps in the Nov 15 win over Dallas and caught 3 passes for 31 yards and a TD (25.9 PPR points). Mike Evans (Achilles) is out, which keeps targets open for him.

players.name: Deion Burks
players.note: Even with Josh Downs and Keenan Allen gone and Alec Pierce on IR, Burks was held without a catch on 2 targets while playing 34 of 59 snaps in the run-heavy Nov 15 win over Miami. The role is there, but it hasn't produced yet.

players.name: Cyrus Allen
players.note: Allen played only 23 of 65 snaps on Nov 15 (2 catches, 44 yards, 1 TD) in Josh Downs' Chiefs debut. Downs' arrival pushes Allen down the target pecking order.

players.name: DeMario Douglas
players.note: Douglas caught 1 of 3 targets for 4 yards on 38 of 59 snaps in the Nov 15 loss to Detroit, with Tommy DeVito at quarterback. New England has its Week 11 bye.

players.name: Brandon Aiyuk
players.note: Aiyuk is still listed DNR. His reinstatement from reserve/left squad is reportedly stalled by a roughly $13 million bonus-forfeiture dispute, and as of Nov 16 there was no report of him being activated, traded or released.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: Smith (hamstring) has missed three straight games, the last of them before Philadelphia's Week 10 bye. Sleeper still lists him out, and Week 11 is the earliest he could return.

players.name: Jaylen Waddle
players.note: Waddle (concussion, Nov 8) went through the protocol during Denver's Week 10 bye. He is aiming to return Nov 22 vs. Las Vegas.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.note: Adams (hamstring, IR) is targeting a return around Weeks 12-13, after the Rams' Week 11 bye. Puka Nacua is also on IR, which he went on Nov 12.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.note: On Nov 11 Shane Steichen said he is unsure whether Pierce (heel, IR since Week 3) will return in 2026.

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.note: Cooper played 1 of 71 snaps on Nov 15 vs. Buffalo before he was ruled out with an aggravation of his ankle injury (he had a high ankle sprain earlier this season). He was set for imaging Monday, Nov 16; no result had been reported as of Tuesday morning.

players.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
players.note: Robinson (ankle) was questionable to return and left the Nov 15 game early, playing 20 of 57 snaps with 3 catches for 10 yards (per Sleeper). Sleeper still lists him as questionable; no post-game update was found.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.note: McConkey (back spasms) sat out the Chargers' Monday night game at Baltimore on Nov 16, and Sleeper still lists him as out. That is his second straight week without game action.

players.name: Tre' Harris
players.note: With McConkey out, Harris caught all 5 of his targets for 86 yards in the Nov 16 Monday night game at Baltimore (per Sleeper).

players.name: Zay Flowers
players.note: Flowers caught 6 of 7 targets for 74 yards in the Nov 16 Monday night game vs. the Chargers (per Sleeper). Lamar Jackson remains on IR, which keeps his ceiling down.

players.name: Justin Jefferson
players.note: With Jordan Addison (thumb) and Jauan Jennings inactive, Jefferson drew 13 targets (9 catches, 74 yards) on 63 of 69 snaps Nov 15 at Green Bay (per Sleeper).

players.name: Ryan Flournoy
players.note: Flournoy played 67 of 83 snaps and caught 6 of 7 targets for 71 yards and a TD in the Nov 15 game (per Sleeper), and he is a popular Week 11 waiver add.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: Evans (Achilles tendinitis) sat out again on Nov 15 at Dallas, and as of Nov 17 no return timeline has been reported.

players.name: Keenan Allen
players.note: In his 49ers debut on Nov 15 at Dallas, with Mike Evans out, Allen played 31 of 65 snaps and caught 5 of 7 targets for 61 yards (per Sleeper). His snap share should grow as he learns the offense.

players.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
players.note: Harrison (hamstring) did not practice late last week and missed the Nov 15 game vs. Cleveland. Houston plays again Thursday, so his Week 11 status is doubtful.

players.name: Nico Collins
players.note: With Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) out Nov 15 vs. Cleveland, Collins drew 16 targets and caught 9 for 94 yards and a TD (per Sleeper). He should stay the focal point if Harrison misses Thursday's game.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.note: Branch (hamstring) missed the Nov 15 game vs. Kansas City, his second straight absence, and no return timeline has been reported.

players.name: Josh Downs
players.note: In his Chiefs debut Nov 15 at Atlanta, Downs played only 11 of 65 snaps but caught 4 of 5 targets for 53 yards and a TD (per Sleeper). His role should grow as he learns the offense.

players.name: Parker Washington
players.note: Washington caught 7 of 9 targets for 152 yards and a TD on 56 of 73 snaps on Nov 15 (per Sleeper), a breakout as Jacksonville's WR1.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.note: Tyson drew 13 targets on Nov 15 and caught 11 for 80 yards (per Sleeper), the kind of rookie volume that makes him a weekly flex option.

players.name: Luther Burden III
players.note: Burden (concussion, Nov 8) is still listed questionable on Sleeper after Chicago's Week 10 bye; he must clear the protocol before Week 11.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.note: Nacua (MCL/PCL sprains, turf toe) has been on IR since Nov 12. With the Rams' Week 11 bye, Week 15 is reportedly his earliest return.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: Doubs (shoulder) remains on IR, and New England's offense took another hit: Drake Maye (ankle) left the Nov 15 loss to Detroit early and is listed out.

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.note: Pittman (foot/plantar fasciitis) remains on IR as of Nov 17 and missed Nov 15 vs. Cincinnati. A return after Pittsburgh's bye is the earliest reported.

players.name: Roman Wilson
players.note: Wilson (finger) remains on IR, and no return date had been reported as of Nov 17.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: Wilson is out for the season with a neck fracture suffered Nov 8 vs. Seattle (announced Nov 9).

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: McLaurin tore his left patellar tendon on Oct 19 and is out for the 2026 season.

players.name: Tyreek Hill
players.note: As of mid-November, Hill remains an unsigned free agent coming off ACL surgery. The NFL says his personal-conduct matter is still under review, so a team that signs him could face a suspension.
